institution.name: The University of Texas at Dallas

plan.notes: Four-year degree plan example transcribed from the UT Dallas 2025-2026 undergraduate catalog. Degree requires 120 semester credit hours.

courses.title: Major Preparatory
courses.choice_note: [3] Major Preparatory - LIT 2350 and 6 SCH of (LIT 2320 or LIT 2321 or LIT 2322 or LIT 2331). - NOTE: If the student took one of these courses as their core, then the student may choose any free elective in its place as a lower-level major requirement.

courses.title: Free Elective
courses.choice_note: [7] Free Elective - any lower or upper-level course. Students may need to take some as upper-level to meet the university requirement of earning a minimum of 45 semester credit hours of upper-level courses.

courses.title: Mathematics Core
courses.choice_note: [2] Students completing the 020 requirement with a MATH course must complete ALEKS exam prior to enrollment. PHIL 2303 does not require the ALEKS exam.
